sentences.zh: 这一集是由贾斯汀·斯皮策编剧的。

sentences.zh: 这一集是贾斯汀完整编剧的第一集。

sentences.en: So, I reached out to him because I've kept in touch with Justin since we wrapped.
sentences.zh: 所以我联系了他，因为自从剧集结束后，我就一直和贾斯汀保持着联系。

sentences.en: He is so lovely.
sentences.zh: 他真是太可爱了。

sentences.en: So, I reached out to Justin, and I asked him, where did the idea for this episode come from?
sentences.zh: 所以我联系了贾斯汀，问他这一集的灵感是从哪里来的？

sentences.en: And he said it was really simple.
sentences.zh: 他说其实很简单。

sentences.en: Greg really wanted to explore this idea of that feeling you get when you have to come back from your vacation and go back to your work grind.

sentences.en: And that was it.

sentences.en: That was, they built the whole story around that one theme.
sentences.zh: 他们就是围绕这个主题构建了整个故事。

sentences.zh: 你知道我喜欢这一点的原因吗？因为我发现我最喜欢的故事往往都有一个非常简单的前提。

sentences.en: They're not heavy on premise, and I find them usually the most relatable.

sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, then I asked Justin, what was it like being your first full script?
sentences.zh: 所以，我问了贾斯汀，第一次独立完成完整剧本是什么感觉？

sentences.en: And he said he was incredibly nervous about doing a good job, and he remembers that it was normal for writers to get a full week to write their first draft.
sentences.zh: 他说他当时非常紧张，想把工作做好，他还记得编剧通常有一整周的时间来写初稿。

sentences.en: You would usually get sent off on a Friday, and you would have the whole next week, and it wouldn't be due until the following Monday.
sentences.zh: 通常周五会把任务派发给你，你有一整周的时间，直到下周一才交稿。

sentences.en: You'd get about nine days.
sentences.zh: 你大概有九天时间。

sentences.en: So, he said that this script, though, they did not finish breaking it until Monday night, pretty late, and Greg said, I'm going to need this Friday morning.
sentences.zh: 所以他说，这次的剧本，他们直到周一晚上很晚才完成大纲，格雷格说，我周五早上就要用到它。

sentences.en: Ah!
sentences.zh: 啊！

sentences.en: So, he only had three days.
sentences.zh: 所以他只有三天时间。

sentences.en: This is reminding me of when Gene and Lee had to do their first script in, like, three days.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起吉恩和李第一次写剧本时，也只用了三天左右。

sentences.en: Yeah, or the time Steve had to write his script over a weekend with his in-laws visiting.
sentences.zh: 没错，还有史蒂夫那次，他在岳父母来访的周末写完了剧本。

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: Justin said he grabbed a case of Diet Coke out of the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 贾斯汀说他从厨房拿了一箱健怡可乐。

sentences.en: He said he basically lived on that for the next 72 hours.
sentences.zh: 他说接下来的72小时他基本就是靠这个活下来的。

sentences.en: Oh, gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And I guess, apparently, after Justin left to go write the script, because you could write your scripts at home, one of the other writers said to Greg, we're not behind.
sentences.zh: 我猜，显然在贾斯汀离开去写剧本后——因为你可以在家写剧本——另一位编剧对格雷格说，我们进度并不落后。

sentences.en: Why does he have to write it so fast?
sentences.zh: 为什么非要让他写得这么快？

sentences.en: And that Greg smiled and said, to keep the pressure up, just tighten in the screws.
sentences.zh: 格雷格笑了笑说，为了保持压力，得拧紧发条。

sentences.en: Oh, Greg!
sentences.zh: 哦，格雷格！

sentences.en: I think in retrospect, it weirdly did relieve some of the pressure of it being the very first script that he was writing,
sentences.zh: 我觉得事后看来，这反而奇怪地减轻了他作为第一次写剧本的压力，

sentences.en: because no one really expects a script that you write in only three days to be very good.
sentences.zh: 因为没人会指望你只花三天写出来的剧本能有多好。

sentences.en: So, he was like, well, this is what it is.
sentences.zh: 所以他想，好吧，就这样吧。

sentences.en: He did a dad mind trick.
sentences.zh: 他用了一招老爸心理战。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: He was like, yeah, I need it in three days.
sentences.zh: 他当时就是说，是的，我三天内就要。

sentences.en: But also knowing that that way, Justin wouldn't, like, make it too precious and take too long with it and kind of just shake off the cobwebs and jump in the deep end.
sentences.zh: 但同时也知道，这样贾斯汀就不会太纠结细节，不会花太长时间，而是能甩掉包袱，直接跳进深水区。

sentences.en: And how many analogies can I use?
sentences.zh: 我还能用多少个比喻？

sentences.en: It was good.
sentences.zh: 挺好的。

sentences.en: I liked them.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢这些比喻。

sentences.en: Well, Justin said he wants everyone to know that what we ended up shooting was way, way better than what he originally wrote.
sentences.zh: 嗯，贾斯汀说他想让大家知道，我们最终拍摄的版本比他最初写的要好得多得多。

sentences.en: That he brought that script back.
sentences.zh: 他把那个剧本带了回来。

sentences.en: And he said he was not able to write the script that you see on the screen in three days.
sentences.zh: 他说他不可能在三天内写出你在屏幕上看到的那个剧本。

sentences.en: It went through a bunch of rewrites.
sentences.zh: 它经过了多次重写。

sentences.en: And basically, he said, if I showed you my first draft, your reaction would be, yeah, that pretty much seems like something it would take a person three days to write.
sentences.zh: 基本上他说，如果我给你们看我的初稿，你们的反应会是，嗯，这看起来确实像是人花三天写出来的东西。

sentences.en: But anyway, I thought that was so sweet.
sentences.zh: 但不管怎样，我觉得这太贴心了。

sentences.en: Well, we had to be there pretending like we were going through boxes, guys.
sentences.zh: 其实当时我们得在那儿假装翻箱倒柜，伙计们。

sentences.en: So we were really doing stuff, which you don't really see.
sentences.zh: 所以我们是真的在干活，虽然你们没怎么看到。

sentences.en: It didn't really make it into the show.
sentences.zh: 那些镜头没怎么剪进正片里。

sentences.en: But I think that he legitimately opened up a box and that was in there and he got all excited.
sentences.zh: 但我认为他当时是真打开了一个箱子，里面正好有那个东西，他就特别兴奋。

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，就是这样。

sentences.en: Well, I have a little Angela Roy moment that happens right at the same time.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我有一个小小的安吉拉和罗伊的瞬间，正好发生在同一时间。

sentences.en: At 14 minutes, 44 seconds, you can see Angela starts to walk up to Roy and is about to, like, go up to him.
sentences.zh: 在14分44秒的时候，你可以看到安吉拉开始走向罗伊，正准备去找他。

sentences.en: And then Daryl yells, I found an iPod dock.
sentences.zh: 然后达里尔大喊：我找到了一个iPod底座。

sentences.en: And I whip my head and I pivot the other way.
sentences.zh: 我猛地一回头，转了个身往另一个方向走了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: You have to go and watch it.
sentences.zh: 你们一定要去看看。

sentences.en: More of the untold Angela Roy story.
sentences.zh: 更多安吉拉和罗伊不为人知的故事。

sentences.en: And I'm wondering, I mean, what was meant to happen there?
sentences.zh: 我在想，我是说，那里本来应该发生什么？

sentences.en: Like, it's not in the script.
sentences.zh: 剧本里没写。

sentences.en: It's not in deleted scenes.
sentences.zh: 删减片段里也没有。

sentences.en: But I'm sure I was given some direction maybe to go over and, you know, in the background sort of talk to Roy.
sentences.zh: 但我肯定当时有人指导我过去，在背景里和罗伊聊聊天什么的。

sentences.en: But yeah, when Daryl yells, I turn around and go the other direction.
sentences.zh: 但确实，当达里尔大喊时，我就转身往另一个方向走了。

sentences.en: It's a fun little catch.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很有趣的小细节。

sentences.en: Well, then we see Pam is doing some inventory and Karen comes up to her and thanks her.
sentences.zh: 接下来我们看到帕姆在做库存盘点，凯伦走过来感谢她。

sentences.en: She says, thank you so much for talking sense into Jim.
sentences.zh: 她说，太感谢你劝通吉姆了。

sentences.en: Karen is so happy.
sentences.zh: 凯伦特别开心。

sentences.en: Her relationship is back on.
sentences.zh: 她的感情生活又恢复正常了。

sentences.en: Everything's okay.
sentences.zh: 一切都好起来了。

sentences.en: And then we cut to Pam just sobbing on a bench in the hallway.
sentences.zh: 然后镜头一转，帕姆正坐在走廊的长椅上啜泣。

sentences.en: And Angela, I watched this scene and it just brought tears to my eyes because I remember shooting it so clearly, so clearly.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，我看了这一幕，眼泪都掉下来了，因为我记得当时拍摄的情景，记得特别清楚，特别清楚。

sentences.en: And we got a lot of questions about it.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了很多关于这一幕的问题。

sentences.en: So we got questions from Joe Salazar, Angie Letworth, Elisa Goldman, Jillian Reilly, and Charlie Sparkenbaugh.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了来自乔·萨拉查、安吉·莱特沃斯、埃莉萨·戈德曼、吉莉安·赖利和查理·斯帕肯鲍的提问。

sentences.en: They wanted to know, how was it filming that iconic Pam and Dwight scene when Pam is crying?
sentences.zh: 他们想知道，拍摄那个经典的帕姆和德怀特的哭戏是什么感觉？

sentences.en: Well, guys, this was like early on in the show.
sentences.zh: 嗯，伙计们，那是剧集早期的时候。

sentences.en: And whenever we had these really emotional scenes, like that parking lot scene with Jim and Pam, we would just kind of shut down everything.
sentences.zh: 每当我们有这种非常情绪化的戏份时，比如吉姆和帕姆在停车场那场戏，我们就会把一切都停下来。

sentences.en: And I remember that we shut down the set and we took hours prepping and shooting this crying scene.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时我们清空了片场，花了几个小时来准备和拍摄这场哭戏。

sentences.en: It was really important to Greg that I really be crying.
sentences.zh: 格雷格非常看重我是否真的在哭。

sentences.en: They did not want to put fake tears in my eyes.
sentences.zh: 他们不想在我的眼睛里滴眼药水。

sentences.en: He wanted me to really go there.
sentences.zh: 他希望我能真正进入那种状态。

sentences.en: And this is a really big challenge for an actor.
sentences.zh: 这对演员来说是一个巨大的挑战。

sentences.en: And so what they did was they made everything really quiet.
sentences.zh: 所以他们所做的就是让周围变得非常安静。

sentences.en: And no one talked to me for about a half hour.
sentences.zh: 大约半小时里没有人跟我说话。

sentences.en: And I put on the saddest music I could find.
sentences.zh: 我放了我能找到的最悲伤的音乐。

sentences.en: And it was sad because it was personal to me, right?
sentences.zh: 那真的很伤感，因为那对我个人而言意义非凡，对吧？

sentences.en: It was music that brought up memories of breakups, music that I listened to at different times in my life when I was having a particularly hard time.
sentences.zh: 那些音乐勾起了我失恋的回忆，是我人生中在特别艰难的时期听过的歌。

sentences.en: So it would bring up a lot of emotions.
sentences.zh: 所以它会引发很多情绪。

sentences.en: And I had spent the previous week creating this playlist because I knew that it would invoke a lot of emotion.
sentences.zh: 我花了一周时间制作了这个播放列表，因为我知道它会激发很多情感。

sentences.en: And I sat and I listened to it until I was crying.
sentences.zh: 我坐在那儿一直听，直到我哭出来。

sentences.en: And then Kelly, our first AD, came and took the headphones away from me.
sentences.zh: 然后我们的第一副导演凯利走过来，拿走了我的耳机。

sentences.en: And then they started rolling.
sentences.zh: 接着他们就开始拍摄了。

sentences.en: And that's how they were able to begin the scene with me crying.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们能让我以哭戏开场的原因。

sentences.en: Because when you play a scene, Angela, and you have dialogue and you have connection with a person,
sentences.zh: 因为安吉拉，当你演一场戏时，如果你有台词，并且与对方有交流，

sentences.en: a lot of times that will bring the emotion out of you.
sentences.zh: 很多时候这会激发你的情绪。

sentences.en: But it's really hard to start a scene in a full cry because you would just have to get yourself there.
sentences.zh: 但要在开场时就大哭真的很难，因为你必须强迫自己进入那种状态。

sentences.en: No, that's so true.
sentences.zh: 不，你说得太对了。

sentences.en: It's actually really hard because you're basically taking yourself emotionally from zero to 60.
sentences.zh: 这其实非常难，因为你基本上是在情感上强行从零加速到一百。

sentences.en: And I had to do a crying scene in a show called Haters Back Off that was like something in the middle.
sentences.zh: 我曾在一部叫《喷子滚开》的剧里演过一场哭戏，大概是在剧情中间的部分。

sentences.en: And I remember they let me sort of just step away from set to get myself there.
sentences.zh: 我记得他们让我离开片场一会儿，好让我自己酝酿情绪。

sentences.en: And once I was there, they started rolling.
sentences.zh: 等我进入状态后，他们就开始拍摄了。

sentences.en: I took this acting class and it was talking about emotional journeys.
sentences.zh: 我上过一个表演课，里面讲到了情感历程。

sentences.en: And the acting teacher encouraged us to pick a song, one song, because sometimes on set,
sentences.zh: 表演老师鼓励我们选一首歌，只选一首，因为有时候在片场，

sentences.en: you don't have the luxury of being able to like go listen.
sentences.zh: 你没有那种奢侈的时间去慢慢听歌。

sentences.en: That really shows how much our show was taking care of you in that moment, I feel like.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这真的体现了当时我们的剧组是多么照顾你。

sentences.en: But sometimes you only have a few minutes to reset yourself emotionally and to get to that place.
sentences.zh: 但有时你只有几分钟时间来调整情绪，让自己进入状态。

sentences.en: So we took, everyone picked one song.
sentences.zh: 所以我们每个人都选了一首歌。

sentences.en: And in your mind, you sing that one song.
sentences.zh: 在脑海里，你跟着唱那首歌。

sentences.en: And by the end of that song, you should be in that emotional place.
sentences.zh: 等到歌唱完的时候，你就应该进入那种情感状态了。

sentences.en: And it really worked for me.
sentences.zh: 这对我很管用。

sentences.en: And I find for myself now, I'm older now, guys.
sentences.zh: 我现在发现，伙计们，我年纪大了。

sentences.en: I'm 49 and more life has happened to me.
sentences.zh: 我已经49岁了，经历过更多的人生起伏。

sentences.en: And it's easier for me to get to that place than when I was a younger actor.
sentences.zh: 比起年轻时，现在我更容易进入那种状态了。

sentences.en: Yeah, same.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我也是。

sentences.en: But music is a big way to trigger it for me.
sentences.zh: 但音乐对我来说是触发情绪的重要方式。

sentences.en: And I think for a lot of actors.
sentences.zh: 我想对很多演员来说也是如此。

sentences.en: I've created musical soundtracks for a lot of things I've done.
sentences.zh: 我为我做过的很多作品都制作过音乐原声带。

sentences.en: I had to do a play and I had to start out the play in a rage.
sentences.zh: 我曾演过一部戏，开场时我必须处于愤怒的状态。

sentences.en: I had to start out very, very angry.
sentences.zh: 我必须一上来就非常、非常生气。

sentences.en: And I couldn't find a song that exactly triggered my anger.
sentences.zh: 但我找不到一首歌能精准地触发我的愤怒。

sentences.en: I had a song that would kind of amp me up.
sentences.zh: 我有一首歌能让我稍微兴奋起来。

sentences.en: And then I realized I had some audio of an ex-boyfriend who I really was pissed at still to this day.
sentences.zh: 后来我意识到，我还有一段前男友的录音，直到今天我想到他还是很生气。

sentences.en: I found this audio tape and I played his voice.
sentences.zh: 我找到了那盘录音带，播放了他的声音。

sentences.en: And it made me so damn mad that I would, you can hear me right now just thinking about it.
sentences.zh: 那真的让我火冒三丈，你现在光听我提起这件事就能听出来。

sentences.en: It made me so damn mad that I could just walk out on stage and start screaming at the other actor on stage because just his voice triggered me.
sentences.zh: 那让我气到可以直接走上舞台，对着另一位演员大吼大叫，因为光是他的声音就足以触发我。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So I think that, you know, music, something you can listen to.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，你知道，音乐，或者任何你可以听的东西。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That works.
sentences.zh: 那很有效。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that goes.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我觉得是这样。

sentences.en: I mean, you guys listening, you can.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你们这些听众，你们也可以。

sentences.en: I know there are songs that take you right back to a moment in your life.
sentences.zh: 我知道有些歌能让你瞬间回到生命中的某个时刻。

sentences.en: That's that's the power and beauty of music, right?
sentences.zh: 这就是音乐的力量和美妙之处，对吧？

sentences.en: The song that like would make me tear up by the end is a lefty Feazell song called That's the Way Love Goes.
sentences.zh: 有一首歌每次听完都会让我热泪盈眶，那是Lefty Frizzell唱的《That's the Way Love Goes》。

sentences.en: So and it's an old song.
sentences.zh: 那是一首老歌。

sentences.en: Some of you will know it.
sentences.zh: 你们有些人可能听过。

sentences.en: Some of you in this moment know that I'm 100 years old because it's a really old song.
sentences.zh: 你们有些人现在肯定觉得我有一百岁了，因为这歌确实很老。

sentences.en: Well, one of the songs I was listening to to help make me cry for Pam was a Ben Fold song,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我当时为了让自己能为帕姆（Pam）那场戏哭出来，听的歌里有一首本·福兹（Ben Folds）的歌，

sentences.en: but I had a whole Pam soundtrack that I would listen to on my drive to work during season three when her and Jim were estranged.
sentences.zh: 但我其实有一整套“帕姆歌单”，在第三季她和吉姆（Jim）疏远期间，我开车上班时都会听。

sentences.en: And it was Nora Jones.
sentences.zh: 里面有诺拉·琼斯（Norah Jones）的歌。

sentences.en: Lady.
sentences.zh: 那位女士。

sentences.en: She's just so soulful and wishing and.
sentences.zh: 她的歌声太深情了，充满了渴望和……

sentences.en: A little loSt.
sentences.zh: 一点点迷茫。

sentences.en: I remember you guys doing the scene and I remember it from the filter of your BFF.
sentences.zh: 我记得你们拍那场戏的时候，我是以你闺蜜的视角来看待的。

sentences.en: And I remember you were really anxious about it.
sentences.zh: 我记得你当时特别焦虑。

sentences.en: You really wanted to get it right.
sentences.zh: 你真的很想把那场戏演好。

sentences.en: You were doing all the prep.
sentences.zh: 你做了所有的准备工作。

sentences.en: I remember when you guys went to do the scene that I left you alone.
sentences.zh: 我记得你们去拍那场戏时，我特意避开了。

sentences.en: You know, you don't need your chatty five foot one.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你不需要我这个一米五五的唠叨鬼在旁边。

sentences.en: I was like, I'm going to give her all the space she needs.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，我要给她留出她所需要的所有空间。

sentences.en: And rewatching it, Jenna, it made me tear up.
sentences.zh: 珍娜（Jenna），重看那场戏时，我真的看哭了。

sentences.en: It's so beautiful.
sentences.zh: 太美了。

sentences.en: And I think I see rain as Dwight tearing up.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得我看到了雷恩（Rainn）作为德怀特（Dwight）在流泪。

sentences.en: But surely Dwight wouldn't tear up.
sentences.zh: 但德怀特肯定不会流泪的。

sentences.en: But I think rain, your friend, is tearing up watching you cry.
sentences.zh: 但我认为雷恩，你的朋友，是在看着你哭的时候自己也跟着哭了。

sentences.en: Angela, it's making me get choked up when you say it because this is a little bit of a place where the line blurred between the rain that you and I know.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉（Angela），你这么说让我哽咽了，因为这确实模糊了我们认识的雷恩和角色之间的界限。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Dwight.
sentences.zh: 还有德怀特。

sentences.en: Rain simply couldn't do that scene without empathizing with Pam.
sentences.zh: 雷恩根本无法在不与帕姆共情的情况下完成那场戏。

sentences.en: Every time we did a take, he teared up when I cried harder.
sentences.zh: 每次我们拍一条，我哭得越厉害，他就跟着流泪。

sentences.en: It was like Rain Wilson, the man, was incapable of sitting next to a person in pain without feeling their pain.
sentences.zh: 就好像雷恩·威尔森（Rainn Wilson）本人，根本无法坐在一个痛苦的人身边而不去感受对方的痛苦。

sentences.en: And this is the thing that we know about rain.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们所了解的雷恩。

sentences.en: It's the thing that we love about rain.
sentences.zh: 也是我们爱他的原因。

sentences.en: And when I saw it in the scene, it just made me miss rain so much because that's who rain is to me on a personal level.
sentences.zh: 当我在戏里看到这一幕时，我真的太想念雷恩了，因为这就是我私下里认识的雷恩。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I just saw rain.
sentences.zh: 我刚才看到了雷恩。

sentences.en: I just saw him and he's tearing up.
sentences.zh: 我刚才看到他了，他正在流泪。

sentences.en: And then he has to snap back to Dwight.
sentences.zh: 然后他得立刻切换回德怀特的状态。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You know, and say the line or, you know, PMSing pretty hard, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，还得说出那句台词，或者说，“经期综合征挺严重的吧”，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: One of my favorite things he does in this scene as Dwight is he takes his jacket off and you're positive he's going to wrap it around Pam.
sentences.zh: 他在那场戏里作为德怀特做的我最喜欢的动作之一，就是他脱下外套，你肯定以为他要给帕姆披上。

sentences.en: And he ties it around his waist so awkwardly.
sentences.zh: 结果他笨拙地把它系在了腰上。

sentences.en: Yes, that was in the script.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是剧本里写的。

sentences.en: That's the other thing.
sentences.zh: 还有一点。

sentences.en: All the little beats, all the moments, him putting his jacket around his waist, giving the handkerchief, awkwardly putting his arm around her shoulder.
sentences.zh: 所有那些细微的节奏，所有的瞬间，他把外套系在腰上，递手帕，笨拙地把手搭在她肩膀上。

sentences.en: All of that is scripted.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都是剧本里写好的。

sentences.en: All those moments.
sentences.zh: 所有那些时刻。

sentences.en: It's just it was a beautifully written scene.
sentences.zh: 那真是一场写得非常精彩的戏。

sentences.en: And they gave us great time to figure it out and shoot it.
sentences.zh: 他们给了我们充足的时间去构思和拍摄。

sentences.en: I'm really proud of that scene.
sentences.zh: 我真的为那一幕感到自豪。

sentences.en: It's one of my favorites from the series that I got to do.
sentences.zh: 那是我在剧集中最喜欢的片段之一。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: You just did it so well.
sentences.zh: 你演得太棒了。

sentences.en: Where are we now?
sentences.zh: 我们现在到哪儿了？

sentences.en: Well, Jan has arrived.
sentences.zh: 嗯，简到了。

sentences.en: Oh, it's so awkward.
sentences.zh: 哦，太尴尬了。

sentences.en: Jan has arrived.
sentences.zh: 简到了。

sentences.en: And you could you could cut the tension, even though we were acting.
sentences.zh: 那种紧张感简直触手可及，尽管我们只是在演戏。

sentences.en: I remember Melora has such a presence.
sentences.zh: 我记得梅洛拉的气场非常强大。

sentences.en: And when she walked into that warehouse, it was like you could hear a pin drop, even though we knew we were acting.
sentences.zh: 当她走进那个仓库时，简直落针可闻，尽管我们知道是在演戏。

sentences.en: It just was a powerful moment.
sentences.zh: 那真是一个震撼的时刻。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Michael's slow walk up the stairs was so good.
sentences.zh: 还有迈克尔慢悠悠走上楼梯的那段，演得真好。

sentences.en: So good.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: So good.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: And then, Jenna, when they get back to Michael's office, what a power move.
sentences.zh: 然后，珍娜，当他们回到迈克尔办公室时，那招反客为主真是绝了。

sentences.en: Jan is sitting in his seat.
sentences.zh: 简坐在了他的位置上。

sentences.en: He has to sit across from her where the other employees would normally sit.
sentences.zh: 他不得不坐在她对面，也就是平时员工坐的地方。

sentences.en: It was so badass.
sentences.zh: 真是太霸气了。

sentences.en: I so loved it.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: So now in this scene, you don't know what's going to happen.
